findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Shelves of the prep table in the middle of the kitchen and floors behind equipment and underneath the triple sink were observed with accumulated food debris. Discussed with PIC. Ensure that physical facilities are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent build up of debris.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 Employees were observed touching body and not washing hands before donning gloves.  Activity was halted on both occasions. Handwashing was discussed. Employee washed their hands prior to putting on a new pair of gloves to continue with prep.
Food Employees shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in food preparation including working with exposed food, clean equipment and utensils, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Hands shall also be washed before putting gloves/between glove changes and after engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The hood baffles above the fryer were observed to have an accumulation of grease debris. The last cleaning visit was July 2023. Next visit is set for July 2024. Discussed with PIC. Ensure that baffles are cleaned and maintained in a manner to prevent grease build-up. 
In addition, some of the shelving under the walk-in cooler is observed soiled with accumulated wrapping materials and there is dust on the walls in the rear storage room over the broom storage. Clean floors and walls to insure areas are void of accumulated soil. 

4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: There are a few small holes in the wall by the mop sink. See that the holes are sealed so walls are smooth and easily cleanable. 
PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Washing fruits and vegetables
findings.citation_text:
3-302.15 Vegetable wash solution was once again not registering at proper concentration. Dispenser ran for ~2 minutes prior to checking concentration. Inspector then set a timer, and dispenser was allowed to run for 5 minutes prior to checking the concentration. Product appeared to be present in the chemical tubing, but freshly dispensed product remained at 0ppm (required range = 5.85-7.81ppm). The mechanism that pushes chemical through tubing was not functioning. Kitchen manager stated the technician came out for service, and dispenser was said to be functioning properly per the store manager. Batteries were said to be replaced since the previous inspection, but due to a delay with the machine a new vegetable wash dispenser has been ordered for replacement. Additional service is needed and/or complete replacement of the system prior to next inspection.
Devices used for on-site generation of chemicals meeting the requirements specified in 21 CFR 173.315, Chemicals used in the washing or to assist in the peeling of fruits and vegetables, for the washing of raw, whole fruits and vegetables shall be used in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 Employee was observed going between tasks and handled boxes prior to putting on gloves to prepare food. Handwashing did not occur prior to donning gloves. Handwashing was discussed. Employee washed their hands prior to putting on a new pair of gloves to continue with prep.
Food Employees shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in food preparation including working with exposed food, clean equipment and utensils, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Hands shall also be washed before putting gloves/between glove changes and after engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.citation_text:
3-304.11 Varying amounts of mold buildup were observed within the grooves and holes of the soda nozzle diffusers. Store manager stated nozzles were just cleaned two days prior. Employee worked on cleaning and sanitizing nozzles during inspection.
Food shall only contact equipment and utensils that are cleaned and sanitized as specified in Parts 4-6 and 4-7 of this Code; single-service and single-use articles; and linens, such as cloth napkins, as specified under § 3 304.13 that are laundered as specified under Part 4-8 of this Code.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 Three spray bottles in kitchen labeled as sanitizer were observed at 0ppm quat, and one of the bottles had bleach in it. Employee was unsure as to when the solutions were prepared. All solutions were discarded during inspection. If spray bottles are used, ensure quat solutions are checked with test strips to verify proper concentration and refreshed as needed to allow for proper sanitization.
A quaternary ammonia compound solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.citation_text:
7-202.12 Solution in a bottle labeled Super San (quat sanitizer) contained a bleach solution that was much stronger than 200ppm and bleached out test strips. Solution was discarded. Ensure proper use of chemicals per product label directions. Also, ensure proper labeling of chemical spray bottles as to the contents.
Toxics shall be used according to the manufacturer's use directions included in labeling, and must not be used in a manner that poses a health hazard or potential risk of cross contamination.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.citation_text:
3-305.11 Shrink wrapped packages of bottled water available for purchase were observed outside the facility on display. Manager was advised bottled water needs to be stored inside the facility. 
Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food in a clean, dry location; where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and at least 6 inches above the floor.

findings.title: Washing fruits and vegetables
findings.citation_text:
3-302.15 Vegetable wash solution was not registering at proper concentration. Product appeared to be present in the chemical tubing, but freshly dispensed product was at 0ppm. Required range of 5.85-7.81ppm is required per product information. Employees noted the dispenser was just serviced recently and said to be fixed. Additional service will be provided. 
Devices used for on-site generation of chemicals meeting the requirements specified in 21 CFR 173.315, Chemicals used in the washing or to assist in the peeling of fruits and vegetables, for the washing of raw, whole fruits and vegetables shall be used in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.citation_text:
4-502.13 Half & half dispensing tube was not cut diagonal and was allowing for product to pool in the tube between uses. Ensure bulk creamer and half and half tubes are properly cut to eliminate ponding product in the tube between uses.
The bulk milk and other such container dispensing tubes shall be cut on the diagonal leaving no more than one inch protruding from the chilled dispensing head.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11 Sanitizer solution was not setup for use in the kitchen. Quat sanitizer was provided in sani-bucket at 200ppm. Ensure sanitizer solutions are setup and available for use prior to beginning food prep and maintained throughout daily operations. 
Sanitizer shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.citation_text:
6-501.18 Toilet in restroom at the end of the hallway was soiled with splash and buildup on the underside of the seat, which was positioned up, as well on surfaces along the rim and in the bowl. Manager cleaned the toilet during the inspection. 
Plumbing fixtures such as handwashing sinks, toilets, and urinals shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
No Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM) was available during the inspection. A CFPM must be at the establishment during all hours of food prep and operation. 

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Observed soil residue and dust accumulation  present on fans in kitchen walk in freezer. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.citation_text: 6-501.110  (C) Observed Employee jacket on soda syrup shelf in dry storage, and a jacket on a rack of drinks in the walk in cooler.  Dressing rooms and lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used if employees regularly change clothes or store personal articles in the establishment while working. Reference 6-501.110.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: No thermometer observed in the pizza hot holding cabinet and the thermometer built into the unit is not operating. Provide a thermometer inside the hot holding cabinet.
findings.citation_text: 750.150(a) All hot units that contain potentially hazardous foods shall contain  a conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed an employee use bare hands to touch the food contact surfaces of the single service pizza slice trays. Trays were discarded and proper handwashing and glove use with ready to eat foods and food contact surfaces was discussed during the inspection.
750-160 Ready to eat foods shall be handled in a manner to minimize direct hand contact.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed several wet wiping cloths sitting on food contact and non food contact surfaces. Store wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution in between use.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed an ice scoop on top of the ice machine that was soiled with dust accumulation. Wash, rinse and sanitize ice scoop and store clean and dry.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the cabinet underneath the soda fountain to be soiled with food splash and soiled rags. Remove rags and clean inside cabinet.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a drip/leak at the faucet at the three compartment sink.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed the hand sink in the kitchen to be separating from the wall. 2) Observed the three compartment sink not sealed to the wall. Seal sinks to the wall.
750-1210(b) Walls and ceilings in walk-in refrigeration units, food preparation areas, equipment washing areas, and toilet rooms shall be smooth, light-cored, non-absorbant, and easily cleanable. Concrete or pumice block in these locations shall be finished and sealed to provide a cleanable surface.

findings.title: Potentially hazardous foods properly thawed
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed barbecue pork thawing at room temperature on the prep table. Pork was pulled this morning to thaw. Proper methods to thaw were discussed.
750-240 Potentially hazardous foods shall be properly thawed by one of the  following method. 1. Under refrigeration 41°F or below, 2. Under  potable running water 70°F or below or below with sufficient water velocity to agitate and float off loose food particles into the over-flow, 3. In microwave as part of the cooking process, 4. As part of the cooking process.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the light switch plate in the dry storage room to be broken in half with half missing. Replace light switch cover.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the floors to be soiled underneath the shelves in the Ice Cream walk in freezer and underneath the ice machine. Clean the floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: CORRECTED> Observed french vanilla and mocha (milk based) in the Caffiato machine to not have date marking. Manager had opened one yesterday and one today, so she placed date makring stickers on items. Label all potentially hazardous foods not to exceed a 7 day hold period.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed coffee filters to be unprotected on center island. Manager placed coffee filters in drawer during inspection.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the following non-food contact surfaces to not be maintained: 1) the sandwich prep cooler has a blocked hose that is leaking into the bottom of the cooler. Facility has placed rags in the bottom of the cooler to collect pooling water. Rags should be removed once cooler is repaired. 2) the open face display cooler is leaking at the bottom onto the floor. A mop head has been placed on the floor to collect the water. Remove mop head once cooler repaired. 3) the doors for the reach in coolers have broken seals, especially the door in front of the milk, where the broken seal impedes the closing of the door. 4) the walk in freezer in the back has a broken seal on the door. Repair non-food contact equipment.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> The tray holding the clean knives was soiled with food debris. Tray was placed in three compartment sink for washing during inspection. Maintain food contact surfaces to be clean.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the hood system  baffles above the pizza oven to be soiled wtih dust accumulation. Clean the hood baffles.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed the hand sink in the back ice machine room to be blocked with a large ice bin which precluded handwashing. Maintain hand sinks to be accessible for handwashing at all times.
750-1120(b) Lavatories shall be accessible to employees at all times.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed a cup being used as a scoop in the pizza freezer for fries and in several topping cambros in the pizza prep cooler. Use a scoop or utensil with a handle to avoid potential cross contaimination..
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Observed a bucket with CL sanitizer at 200 ppm CL with no CL test strips availble in the facility. Provide test strips for each sanitizer used in the facility.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
CORRECTED > Observed the CL concentration in the 3 compartment sink to be 200 ppm. Sanitizer was changed to 200 ppm quat.
750-820d Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4).

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed a sanitizer cloth storage bucket at 200 ppm. Cloths must be stored in a bucket with a CL concentration of 100 ppm.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
New > Observed the spouts on both coffe makers to be soiled black. Clean coffee maker spouts. REPEAT > Observed the ice maker deflector to be soiled with mold. Clean ice machine deflector often enough to not allow mold to accumiliate.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Repeat > Observed the drain recieving the self serve soda line to be soiled. Clean drain collar.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: 750-151(a) A number of foods within the sub cooler and the pizza cooler did not have date markings. Discussed labeling with staff during inspection. Cheese sauce, cheese slices, and cheese shreds, beans, meatballs, bbq all items removed from original package OR opened must bare the day product was removed or opened. Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Foods properly cooked and/or reheated
findings.comment: 750-250  Observed a hot holding container of meatballs to be holding at 123-127F. The two additional items within the hot holding unit were observed at appropriate temperatures. During inspection, meatballs were discarded as they have been in unit since the opening that day. Make sure that product is being regularly stirred to allow for consistent heating throughout food. Also, get familiar with probe thermometers located in drawer directly across from hot holding unit. A temperature log assures that foods are being held at proper temperature. All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 135°F or above  while on display and service.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment: 750-810b: Observed a moist cloth on the counter adjacent to the quat sani-bucket. Cloth was placed within bucket during inspection. Store cloths used for wiping down kitchen surfaces within the sanitizer buckets between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750-800(b) The baffle of the ice machine is moldy. Clean and sanitize the inside of the ice machine on a regular basis that prevents the accumulation of molds along this surface.  To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: 750-1060 There is a small leak at the hot water faucet of the pizza three-compartment sink. All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.comment: 750-1120(b) The lavatory adjacent to the ice machine in the back of the building is observed obstructed with plastic ice carrying container and two pieces of plastic edging. Items removed from sink during inspection. See violation #32 also. Keep handsinks unobstructed to allow for easy handwashing. Use handsinks ONLY for handwashing. Lavatories shall be accessible to employees at all times.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750-1110d The handsink in the back room adjacent to the ice machine is soiled with accumulated soil and hair. Clean the handsink and then use handsink for only handwashing. See violation 31. Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1220 The drain receiving the self-service soda machine is completely filthy (open pizza kitchen cabinets beneath the soda dispenser). Clean the drain routinely to prevent the accumulation of soil and soda syrups. Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: 750-130(b) There are bags of ice being stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer in the back. Also, there are boxes of food on the floor of the walk-in cooler off of the deli. Properly stored food at least six inches off the floor. Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.comment: 750-280 Cups are being used as scoops within the pizza prep. cooler. Cease the use of the cups. You should use a proper scoop to fill cups. Cups should not directly be inserted into the food. Food handlers & consumers shall avoid direct hand contact with ready to eat foods.  When handling ready to eat foods use suitable utensils (gloves, tongs, scoop, deli tissue, etc.)

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-650a Two of the lids of the pizza dough mix cart are cracked. Replace these two cracked lids with some that are smooth and easily cleanable.  Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Pre-flushed, scraped, soaked
findings.comment: 750-820c There is a bucket holding 'clean' lids on a shelf above the 3-part sink in the pizza kitchen. These lids still had perfect date marking stickers attached. It is necessary to scrub these lids so the stickers are removed. Failure to remove these stickers = dishes are not being properly prewashed, scraped, washed, rinsed and sanitized. Equipment and utensils shall be pre-flushed or pre-scraped and, when necessary, pre-soaked to remove gross food particles and soil.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment: 750-810b There were wet wiping cloths observed on the counters within the store and the deli. During the inspection, the deli cloth was properly stored within a sani-bucket (see violation 41). Later, the frontline counter bleach cloth was also properly stored. The need to have at least three sep. bleach buckets available for pizza, deli, and store was discussed. Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750-800d Baffle of the ice machine was coated with mold! This surface needs to be sanitized DAILY! During the inspection, the ice machine was turned off and cleaning was discussed with the manager. The unit will be cleaned before the end of the day. Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: 750-880 Boxes of cups and a unit of pizza boxes was observed stored on the floor around the pizza oven. Discussed proper storage of these items with the pizza chef. Properly stored during the inspection. Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1220 The fans of the cooling unit of the walk-in cooler are soiled. Clean these fans. Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.comment: 750-1280 A coat is observed on ice cream mix next to the walk-in freezer in the back. Properly stored on the coat rack, not two feet away, during the inspection. Take the needed additional seconds to insure that coats are properly hung after working within the walk-in freezer. Do not store coats, hats, etc on food. Adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food preparation and food storage area to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment: 750-1310 A container of Clorox bleach wipes was observed on the bread warmer amoungst croissants and deli papers. During the inspection, the bleach wipes were stored on the floor of the pizza handsink. All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment: 750-1320 Clorox bleach wipes were observed being used as food contact surface cleaner within the deli. During the inspection, the need to cease use of these wipes was discussed. These wipes are not approved for food contact surface cleaning. A proper sanitizer bucket of bleach was created. Use a cloth and bleach bucket for cleaning of surfaces within the deli and sandwich kitchens. Chemicals necessary for food contact surface cleaning shall not impart any residual odors or chemicals on the surface. Only those chemicals necessary for food contact surface sanitizing shall be used for such proposes. The bleach wipes were removed from service during the inspection.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: 750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor. Bags of ice observed to be stored on the floor of the back walk in freezer.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleansable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices. The cutting board used for pizza is soiled with black mold in the scores left by knives or the pizza cutter. Replace the pizza cutting board.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use. The following food contact surfaces are soiled: 1) pizza cutting board 2) coffee maker water spout area 3) ice machine drop guard. Wash, rinse and sanitize the above listed equipment and maintain clean.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris. The following non-food contact surfaces are observed to be soiled: 1) outsides of frosting pans soiled with rust looking substance 2) the first bin of coffee lids is soiled with sticky soil.  Clean and keep clean.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: 750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  The cutting boards and a pizza cutter are observed to be stored on the back of the faucet at the 3 part sink. Store in an area that protects them from splash and other potential contamination.
